THE BANKING ACT, 2011. Short title.
Being an Act to provide for the licensing of persons carrying
on banking business, the regulation and supervision of banking
activities, the protection of depositors and to provide for other related
matters with a view to developing and promoting a safe and sound
banking system in Sierra Leone.
